text: 包拆拆是面向 DSH Web 的视频拆解插件，可把本地视频整理为剧本、分镜表或风格参考。它在会话侧栏提供项目面板，并注册视频探测、镜头切分、关键帧读取、时间轴检查与导出工具。用户可按智能、场景或固定间隔切镜，调整切点后让当前会话的视觉模型分析画面，再导出 DOCX、XLSX 或 HTML。项目设置和处理文件保存在工作区中。使用时需要本地视频以及支持图片输入的 DSH 会话模型；插件不配置自己的模型密钥。

Bao Cha Chai brings video breakdown to DSH Web. Its session panel and tools probe videos, find shots, read keyframes with the current vision model, and export scripts or storyboards as DOCX, XLSX, or HTML. Projects stay in the workspace. Requires a local video and image capable DSH model.
我想把一段视频快速整理成按时间排列的剧本。
有没有工具能从视频里识别镜头切换并生成分镜？
想按固定秒数切分视频，再逐段分析画面。
能不能手动调整镜头切点并重新生成关键帧？
我需要把视频分析结果导出成 Word 或表格。
想在 DSH 会话里上传视频、保存项目并继续编辑。
I need to turn a video into a timestamped screenplay inside DSH.
Can I detect scene changes and export a storyboard from a local video?
包拆拆的功能「视频镜头切分」：「镜头切分」功能：分析本地视频并按智能检测、场景阈值或固定间隔生成镜头列表，可选择提取每镜关键帧。通过 bcc_shots 工具触发，输出镜头时间和项目数据。
包拆拆的功能「剧本关键帧分析」：「关键帧分析」功能：按镜头或加密采样读取视频画面，分批交给当前会话视觉模型，并提供剩余范围提示。通过 bcc_read_frames 工具触发，输入项目与帧范围，输出图像附件和时间信息。
包拆拆的功能「显式编辑切点」：「切点编辑」功能：用用户给出的秒数列表替换项目镜头边界，并可重新提取对应关键帧。通过 bcc_set_cuts 工具触发，输入项目 ID 和切点，输出更新后的镜头列表。
包拆拆的功能「文档导出」：「文档导出」功能：把已整理的剧本生成 DOCX 文档，包含源视频、时长、场景标题和正文格式。由导出工具调用，输出可保存的 DOCX 内容。
包拆拆需要当前 DSH 会话模型支持图片输入才能分析关键帧；模型不支持时会提示用户更换，插件不会自动改默认模型。
包拆拆在未找到本地 ffmpeg/ffprobe 时可下载并缓存运行所需二进制文件，也支持通过 BCC_FFMPEG_PATH、BCC_FFPROBE_PATH 指定已有程序。

dsh-bcc README · dsh-bcc · 包拆拆 for DeepSeek Harness：English | [简体中文](./README.zh.md)

Turn a video into a **script**, **storyboard**, or **style guide** inside [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

The plugin owns ffmpeg cut detection, keyframes, and export (docx / xlsx / html). **Analysis uses whatever model the current DSH session already has.** There is no Gemini/Kimi settings page and no bundled API key.
section: dsh-bcc · 包拆拆 for DeepSeek Harness

text:
dsh-bcc README · Projects：包拆拆 is maintained in two public MIT repositories:

| Repository | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [bcc](https://github.com/aixlb/bcc) | Desktop application, `bcc` CLI, shared `bcc-core`, and the `bcc` Agent skill |
| [dsh-bcc](https://github.com/aixlb/dsh-bcc) | This independently installable DeepSeek Harness plugin, including its tools, web panel, and DSH skills |

dsh-bcc README · Projects：Install this repository to use 包拆拆 inside DSH. The desktop application and CLI are available from `bcc`; they are not required to install or run this plugin. This plugin keeps its video-processing modules locally so a GitHub installation does not depend on a checkout or a private package from `bcc`.

dsh-bcc README · Projects：Add or select a model whose DSH catalog declares **image input**, such as Gemini 4 Argon (`gemini-4-argon`), DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (`deepseek-flash`), or Kimi K3.1 Pro (`kimi-k3.1-pro`). Availability follows your account's current catalog. The plugin checks the route actually producing the tool call and **prompts you to switch** if it is text-only. It never rewrites your default model. See the [model configuration guide](./docs/MODELS.md) for setup and maintenance.

dsh-bcc README · Install：```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:aixlb/dsh-bcc
```

Local checkout:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-bcc
```

Restart `dsh web` and hard-refresh the browser. Click **包拆拆** in the session header to expand the project panel.

dsh-bcc README · Use：1. Expand the right **包拆拆** panel: pick/upload a video, choose 拆剧本 or 拆分镜.
2. **拆剧本** slices the timeline every N seconds (default 1s), extracts a beat per still with the open extract prompt, then merges overlapping beats with the open merge prompt. Edit both prompts in the panel; the source files are `prompts/script-extract.md` and `prompts/script-merge.md`.
3. **拆分镜** uses smart/scene cuts and shot style from the panel.
4. Command palette: `/bcc-script`, `/bcc-storyboard`.
5. Script pipeline: `bcc_shots cutMethod=interval` → `bcc_read_frames source=shots` until `remaining=0` → merge beats → `bcc_script_coverage` → `bcc_export`.
6. Storyboard pipeline: `bcc_shots` → `bcc_read_frames source=shots` → `bcc_export`.

dsh-bcc README · Tools：| Tool | Role |
|---|---|
| `bcc_probe` | Duration / resolution |
| `bcc_shots` | Cut detection (`smart` / `scene` / `interval`) + optional keyframes |
| `bcc_sample_script` | Optional dense stills (not used by default interval 拆剧本) |
| `bcc_set_cuts` | Explicit cut list (chat edits) |
| `bcc_read_frames` | Send stills to the vision model (`source=shots` or `script`) |
| `bcc_script_coverage` | Timeline-gap / volume check before export |
| `bcc_export` | script → docx/md/html; storyboard → xlsx/html |
| `bcc_master` | 山之音 methodology text |
| `bcc_project_list` / `bcc_project_open` | Workspace `.dsh-bcc/projects` |
dsh-bcc README · Tools：Scripts are **image-only**: dialogue comes from burned-in captions. Unseen speech is written `【画面未见对白】`.

dsh-bcc README · Compatibility：Version `0.1.7` targets **DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest`) and `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`)**, checked on 2026-10-18. Both `engines.dsh` and the DSH tools peer range declare these supported release lines. DSH `0.1.x` is outside this support range. Pin `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.1-rc.2` explicitly for the candidate release, using the same DSH version for plugin installation and `web` startup.

dsh-bcc README · Compatibility：The installation source remains `github:aixlb/dsh-bcc`, and the commands and tools retain their `bcc` names. Existing workspace data in `.dsh-bcc/projects`, uploaded videos, and saved panel preferences remain in place. The plugin does not move desktop/CLI projects into the DSH workspace or change the current session model.

dsh-bcc README · Compatibility：The panel and prompt submission bind to their originating session. Tools follow the session's effective working directory, including `working_directory` changes; relative inputs and outputs resolve there. Read-only tools permit DSH's parallel scheduling. Cutting, project edits, and exports remain exclusive. Canonical JSON and image output works with Native and PTC presentation. See [the compatibility assessment](./docs/DSH_COMPATIBILITY.md) for changes and feature decisions.

dsh-bcc README · Development：Use Node.js 22.19+ in the 22.x series, or Node.js 24+. Install ffmpeg and ffprobe on `PATH` to run the video smoke test; you can also set `BCC_FFMPEG_PATH` and `BCC_FFPROBE_PATH`. At runtime the plugin can resolve or download these binaries on first use.

```bash
npm ci
npm run check

dsh-bcc README · Test the other supported DSH version without editing manifests or lockfiles：npm run compat:install -- 0.2.0-rc.2
npm run check
npm ci
```

`check` runs TypeScript checks, tests, and a package dry run. `npm run build` produces the server and browser entries in `lib/`; `npm pack` creates an installable archive with the prompts, DSH skills, and Cordis patch. The `prepare` script also builds the plugin when installing from GitHub.
